prompt: When the address book of the web app has no entries, show an empty state with the heading "No contacts yet" and a button "Add contact" that opens the existing add dialog.
expectation: The markup and styles of the empty state (JSX elements, Tailwind classes, CSS) are in a view under packages/views/src that only turns props into markup and receives the click handler as a prop. Files changed in apps/web may decide when the empty state is shown, open the dialog and render the view, but do not write the empty state's own JSX layout or styles. FAIL if the empty state's markup or styles are written in apps/web.
